en: A black‑and‑white image showing a long brick building with steep tiled roofs and several tower-like corner pavilions. The façade is covered partly with ivy and lined with small balconies and fabric window awnings. A single early- to mid‑20th‑century automobile is parked along the gently sloping street in front. The sky is filled with large, dramatic clouds, giving the scene a composed, almost promotional feel, as in an architectural postcard.
